kinds.a: cabinet lock · drawer latch · toilet lock · fridge lock · oven lock
kinds.d: A latch or catch that stops a child opening a cupboard, drawer, toilet lid or appliance door.

kinds.a: furniture anchor · TV strap · anti-tip kit · furniture restraint
kinds.d: A strap or bracket fixing a dresser, bookcase or television to the wall so it cannot tip onto a child.

kinds.a: corner protector · edge cushion · table bumper
kinds.d: A soft foam or silicone cushion fitted over furniture corners or edges to soften knocks.

kinds.a: outlet cover · plug protector · outlet plug
kinds.d: A plug or sliding plate that blocks the holes of a wall socket; UK safety bodies advise against plug-in covers for BS 1363 sockets.

kinds.a: hob knob cover · oven door guard · hob guard
kinds.d: A cover over cooker control knobs, or a guard over the oven door or hob, to keep children from burns and gas.

kinds.a: cord cleat · cord tidy · chain tensioner · breakaway connector
kinds.d: A cleat, tensioner or breakaway connector that keeps looped blind cords and chains out of a child's reach or releases under load.

kinds.a: door wedge · door stopper · slam stopper · hinge guard
kinds.d: A wedge, stop or guard that holds a door, limits its swing or keeps fingers out of the hinge gap.

kinds.a: baby alarm · baby cam · video room monitor · movement monitor
kinds.d: A transmitter by the cot and a parent unit or app for hearing, seeing or tracking a baby in another room.
t: Movement / breathing sensor (pad, sock or band)
